MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string. Paste the connection string from your MongoDB Atlas cluster.

JWT_SECRET.description: Automatically generated by Heroku. Used to sign login sessions.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Automatically generated by Heroku. Used as the AES-256-GCM encryption key.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email address that receives admin role when registering.

TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY.description: Optional TikTok Login Kit client key. Leave blank until your app is approved.

TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional TikTok Login Kit client secret. Leave blank until your app is approved.

TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI.description: Optional approved TikTok OAuth redirect URI.
